info.title: EntryHub API
info.description: Room booking: rooms, bookings with business rules and a live occupancy stream.

get.summary: Reports whether the API and its database are reachable.
get.description: Readiness for clients, as JSON. Kubernetes and the Aspire AppHost do not call this one: they use /health (readiness) and /alive (liveness), described under the Probes tag, which sit outside the versioned API and answer plain text.

get.summary: Lists the changes made to bookings, rooms, sites, rules, the catalog, holidays and blocks, newest first, with paging. Facilities only.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: Only changes to this type of thing.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: Only changes to this thing.

parameters.name: ActorId
parameters.description: Only changes made by this person.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only changes at or after this moment.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only changes before this moment.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: One-based page number; defaults to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Items per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

get.summary: Says who is calling: user, role and tenant.
Gets the booking rules of the caller's tenant.

put.summary: Sets the booking rules of the caller's tenant. Facilities only. Applies to new bookings.

get.summary: Lists the sites of the tenant.

parameters.name: IncludeInactive
parameters.description: Also return deactivated sites. Only Facilities get them; for anyone else it is ignored.

patch.summary: Edits a site or deactivates it. Facilities only.

get.summary: Lists the days a site is closed, optionally between two dates.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only holidays on or after this day.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only holidays on or before this day.

post.summary: Closes a site on a day: its rooms cannot be booked that day. Facilities only.

delete.summary: Opens the site again on that day. Existing bookings are not affected. Facilities only.

get.summary: Lists the equipment and accessibility catalog of the tenant.

parameters.name: IncludeInactive
parameters.description: Also return deactivated entries. Only Facilities get them; for anyone else it is ignored.

post.summary: Adds an entry to the catalog. Facilities only.

patch.summary: Renames a catalog entry or deactivates it. Facilities only.

get.summary: Lists rooms, optionally filtered, with paging.

parameters.name: Floor
parameters.description: Only rooms on this floor.

parameters.name: MinCapacity
parameters.description: Only rooms that fit at least this many people.

parameters.name: IncludeInactive
parameters.description: Also return deactivated rooms. Only Facilities get them; for anyone else it is ignored.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: One-based page number; defaults to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Items per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Only rooms of this site.

parameters.name: Features
parameters.description: Codes from `GET /features` separated by commas; only rooms that have all of them.

patch.summary: Edits a room or deactivates it. Facilities only.

get.summary: Gets a room by id.
Lists the rooms that are free for a time slot.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Start of the slot to book.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: End of the slot to book.

parameters.name: Attendees
parameters.description: People that must fit; the room needs at least this capacity.

parameters.name: MinCapacity
parameters.description: Only rooms that fit at least this many people.

parameters.name: Floor
parameters.description: Only rooms on this floor.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Only rooms of this site.

parameters.name: Features
parameters.description: Codes from `GET /features` separated by commas; only rooms that have all of them.

get.summary: Gets the busy ranges of a room in a time window.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Start of the window.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: End of the window; at most 31 days after From.

get.summary: Live occupancy of a room as server-sent events.
Lists the time ranges in which a room cannot be booked, optionally within a window.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only blocks that end after this moment.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only blocks that start before this moment.

post.summary: Blocks a room for a time range, such as cleaning or repairs. Facilities only. Refused with 409 while confirmed bookings are in the range; the response lists them in 'bookingIds'.
Books a room, enforcing the booking rules. Facilities can book for another user with onBehalfOf.
post.description: Send an optional Idempotency-Key header to retry safely: the same key with the same body returns the original booking (header Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of creating another; the same key with a different body returns 422. Keys are private to each user and are remembered for 24 hours.

get.summary: Lists the bookings of every person, filtered, with paging. Facilities only.

parameters.name: RoomId
parameters.description: Only bookings of this room.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only bookings that end after this moment.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only bookings that start before this moment.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Only bookings in this status; every status when omitted.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: One-based page number; defaults to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Items per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Only bookings of rooms of this site.

get.summary: Lists the caller's bookings, with paging.

parameters.name: IncludeCancelled
parameters.description: Also return cancelled bookings; they are hidden by default.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: One-based page number; defaults to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Items per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

get.summary: Gets a booking by id.

post.summary: Cancels a booking before it starts.
post.description: With scope=series (the value is not case-sensitive), the booking and all the later occurrences of its series are cancelled, the ones that the cancellation notice no longer allows are kept, and the response (200) lists both. Without it, or with scope=occurrence, only this booking is cancelled (204).

post.summary: Moves a booking to another time or room, keeping its id. Organizer or Facilities.
Confirms that the people of a booking showed up. Allowed from 15 minutes before the start until the end, to the organizer and to Facilities. Checking in twice keeps the first moment.
Confirms a pending booking. Facilities only. Anything but a pending booking gets 409.
Rejects a pending booking: it is cancelled and the room is free again. The body with a reason is optional. Facilities only.

get.summary: Downloads everything the tenant has stored as one JSON document: sites, holidays, catalog, rooms, blocks, rules, bookings and the audit trail. The export is itself recorded in the audit trail. Facilities only.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes everything the tenant has stored: bookings, rooms, sites, holidays, catalog, blocks, rules and the audit trail. It all happens in one transaction. The tenant itself and one audit entry about the deletion stay. Facilities only; the body must confirm with the name of the tenant. Export the data first.

get.summary: Lists the webhook subscriptions of the tenant (without their secrets). Facilities only.

post.summary: Subscribes an https URL to booking events. The response shows the signing secret once. Facilities only.

patch.summary: Enables or disables a subscription. Facilities only.

get.summary: Lists what happened when events were sent to a subscription, newest first. Facilities only.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Only deliveries in this state (`Pending`, `Succeeded` or `Failed`).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Items per page.

get.summary: Readiness probe: every health check passes, PostgreSQL included.

503.description: Unhealthy: a check failed, usually because PostgreSQL does not answer. Kubernetes stops sending traffic to the pod.

get.summary: Liveness probe: the process responds.

503.description: Unhealthy: the process is not responding. Kubernetes restarts the pod.

actorId.description: Who made it (the `sub` of the token).

summary.description: The name of what was created, or the fields that changed (never their values).

AuditResponse.description: One change made through the API.

cancelled.description: Ids of the bookings that were cancelled (already cancelled ones are not listed).

kept.description: Occurrences that stay booked, each with the rule that kept it (for example, the cancellation notice).

CancelSeriesResponse.description: The result of cancelling a series from one occurrence on.

endAt.description: The block ends here; must be after StartAt.

CreateBookingRequest.description: The shape of the body. Rules that need data or a clock are checked later, in the handler.

name.description: Name to show; unique among the entries of the tenant, ignoring case.

date.description: The day the site is closed, in its own time zone (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

name.description: Unique among the rooms of the site.

equipment.description: Names of what the room has. A name that matches an entry of the catalog (ignoring case) uses it; a new name adds an equipment entry to the catalog.

siteId.description: Site of the room; the oldest active site of the tenant when left out.

featureIds.description: Ids of active entries of the catalog the room has, added to the ones named in Equipment.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: Minutes the room stays free before each booking; none when left out.

bufferAfterMinutes.description: Minutes the room stays free after each booking; none when left out.

requiresApproval.description: Bookings by Employees wait for approval; false when left out.

name.description: Unique among the sites of the tenant.

openDays.description: Monday to Friday when left out.

url.description: Where to send the events: `https`, with a public host name or address.

events.description: What to be told about: `booking.created`, `booking.cancelled` or `booking.rescheduled`.

confirmation.description: The text `DELETE`, a space and the exact name of the tenant, as `GET /tenant/export` shows it (for example `DELETE Acme`).

DeleteTenantDataRequest.description: Deleting everything cannot be undone, so the request must say so in words.

features.description: Entries of the equipment catalog removed.

auditEntries.description: Entries of the audit trail removed.

DeleteTenantDataResponse.description: What was removed. The tenant itself and one audit entry about the deletion stay.

id.description: Identifier to give to a room.

code.description: Stable lowercase identifier, such as `video-conferencing`; the `features` filter uses it.

isActive.description: A deactivated entry cannot be given to a room; the rooms that have it keep it.

FeatureResponse.description: An entry of the catalog of the tenant.

bookingId.description: The booking that was not cancelled.

userId.description: The `sub` claim of the token; the same value as `organizerId` on the bookings of this person.

tenantId.description: The customer this person belongs to, from the token.

tenantName.description: The display name of that customer.

interval.description: Every how many days or weeks, from 1 to 52.

count.description: How many occurrences to create, including the first one (up to 52).

until.description: Last day, in the time zone of the site, on which an occurrence may start.

RecurrenceRequest.description: Makes the booking repeat. Send exactly one of Count and Until.

reason.description: Why the booking is rejected, shown to whoever reads the booking.

roomId.description: New room; the current one when left out.

RescheduleBookingRequest.description:
Moves a booking to another time and, optionally, another room. The booking keeps its id, title, organizer and
attendees. The new time must pass the same rules as a new booking.

endAt.description: The block ends here; this moment is free again.

reason.description: Why the room is blocked, such as "Cleaning".

RoomBlockResponse.description: A time range in which a room cannot be booked.

status.description: Whether the room is in use at At.

at.description: The moment the snapshot was taken.

nextChange.description: When the status will change: the end of the current use, or the start of the next one.

name.description: Unique among the rooms of the site.

equipment.description: Names of what the room has, the same as in Features; kept for clients that only show text.

features.description: What the room has, from the catalog of the tenant.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: Minutes the room stays free before each booking.

bufferAfterMinutes.description: Minutes the room stays free after each booking.

requiresApproval.description: A booking of this room made by an Employee waits for approval by Facilities.

isActive.description: A deactivated room is not listed and cannot be booked.

bookingId.description: The booking; `null` when the caller may not see it.

title.description: Title of the booking; `null` when the caller may not see it.

organizerId.description: Organizer of the booking; `null` when the caller may not see it.

RoomScheduleEntry.description: One busy range of a room. Everyone sees when it is taken; only Facilities and the organizer see what it is.

type.description: A URI that identifies the kind of problem.

title.description: A short summary of the problem.

detail.description: The messages of the broken rules, joined.

violations.description: Every rule the booking breaks, with a stable code.

RulesBrokenProblem.description: A booking that breaks one or more booking rules.

slotMinutes.description: Starts and ends fall on multiples of this length.

officeOpens.description: First start time of the day at the default site (the oldest active one), `HH:mm`, in TimeZone. Each site has its own: see `GET /sites`.

officeCloses.description: Last end time of the day, `HH:mm`, in TimeZone.

officeDays.description: Days of the week rooms can be booked.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the office: the one the hours and the days refer to.

minLeadTimeMinutes.description: A booking starts at least this many minutes from now.

maxAdvanceDays.description: A booking starts at most this many days from now.

cancellationNoticeMinutes.description: An Employee can cancel until this many minutes before the start.

maxActiveBookings.description: Active bookings the caller can hold; `null` when there is no limit.

autoReleaseMinutes.description: Minutes after the start that a confirmed booking nobody checked in to is cancelled by the system; 0 when the release is off.

RulesResponse.description:
The booking rules of the tenant of the token, the ones a client can show or check before it sends a booking. The server still decides: a booking that
breaks a rule gets a 422 with the code of the rule.

code.description: Stable identifier that clients can switch on.

SeriesOccurrence.description:
One occurrence of a series: booked when BookingId is set, otherwise skipped for the rules in
Violations.

id.description: Identifier of the series, also in `seriesId` of each created booking.

requested.description: How many occurrences the recurrence asked for.

created.description: How many of them were booked.

occurrences.description: Every requested occurrence, booked or skipped.

SeriesOutcome.description:
What a recurring request produced: one entry for each occurrence it asked for. Only the response that creates the
series has it.

date.description: The day, in the time zone of the site.

name.description: What the day is, such as "New Year".

SiteHolidayResponse.description: A day on which a site is closed.

name.description: Unique among the sites of the tenant.

opens.description: First start time of the day, `HH:mm`.

closes.description: Last end time of the day, `HH:mm`.

openDays.description: Days of the week the rooms of the site can be booked.

isActive.description: A deactivated site and its rooms are not listed and cannot be booked.

SiteResponse.description: A place with rooms. The hours and the days refer to TimeZone.

oneOf.description: The rules the tenant stored; `null` when it uses the defaults of the platform.

holidays.description: All closed days of the sites.

features.description: The whole catalog, active or not.

rooms.description: All rooms, active or not, with what they have.

TenantExportResponse.description: Everything stored for the tenant of the token, in the same shapes the API returns elsewhere.

TenantRulesExport.description: The booking rules the tenant stored.

name.description: New name; unique among the entries of the tenant, ignoring case.

isActive.description: `false` stops new rooms from getting it; the rooms that have it keep it.

UpdateFeatureRequest.description:
Fields left out are not changed. The code never changes, and an entry is never deleted: a room may use it, so the
only way to retire it is IsActive = `false`.

name.description: New name; unique among the rooms of the site.

equipment.description: Names of what the room has; a name that matches an entry of the catalog (ignoring case) uses it, a new name adds an equipment entry.

isActive.description: `false` takes the room out of the listings and out of new bookings; the bookings it already has stay.

siteId.description: Move the room to another active site of the tenant.

featureIds.description: Ids of active entries of the catalog the room has.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: New minutes the room stays free before each booking; applies to bookings made or moved from now on.

bufferAfterMinutes.description: New minutes the room stays free after each booking; applies to bookings made or moved from now on.

requiresApproval.description: Whether bookings by Employees wait for approval; applies to bookings made from now on.

UpdateRoomRequest.description: Fields left out are not changed. When Equipment or FeatureIds is sent, what the room has is replaced by both together.

slotMinutes.description: Starts and ends fall on multiples of this length; it must divide an hour.

minLeadTimeMinutes.description: A booking starts at least this many minutes from now.

maxAdvanceDays.description: A booking starts at most this many days from now.

cancellationNoticeMinutes.description: An Employee can cancel until this many minutes before the start.

maxActiveBookings.description: Active bookings an Employee can hold.

autoReleaseMinutes.description: Minutes after the start that a confirmed booking nobody checked in to is cancelled by the system; 0 (also when left out) turns it off.

UpdateRulesRequest.description:
The rules of the tenant. All fields are required: the tenant keeps exactly what is sent. Opening hours, days and
time zone belong to each site, see `PATCH /sites/{id}`.

name.description: New name; unique among the sites of the tenant.

isActive.description: `false` takes the site and its rooms out of the listings and out of new bookings; the bookings they already have stay.

UpdateSiteRequest.description: Fields left out are not changed. OpenDays replaces the whole list when it is sent.

isEnabled.description: False pauses the subscription without deleting it.

secret.description: Signs every delivery with HMAC-SHA256. Store it now: it is not shown again.

eventId.description: Identifier of the event, also in the body that was sent.

status.description: Pending while attempts remain, then Succeeded or Failed.

attempts.description: How many times it was sent.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next attempt is due, while it is pending.

lastStatusCode.description: HTTP status of the last attempt, when the receiver answered.

completedAt.description: When it succeeded or was given up.

WebhookDeliveryResponse.description: What happened when an event was sent to a subscription. The body is not included.

WebhookResponse.description: A webhook subscription. The signing secret is only in the response that creates it.

Bearer.description: A JWT with the role Employee or Facilities. In development: dotnet user-jwts create.

tags.name: Probes
tags.description: For Kubernetes and the Aspire AppHost, not for clients. /health is readiness: every check must pass, PostgreSQL included, and Kubernetes holds traffic back until it does. /alive is liveness: it only says the process responds, with no dependencies, and Kubernetes restarts the pod when it fails. A database outage must not restart the pods, which is why the two are separate. GET /api/v1/health is the same readiness question for clients: it answers JSON, belongs to the versioned API and is part of the contract.
